pages.text: A Slaughtergleam is an Arcane Gem formed from a red-spectrum piece of $(l:items/shaped_quartz)Shaped Radiant Quartz$() in an asscher cut.$(br2)When held, your attacks are considered to have one level of the Looting enchantment. If you are wielding a weapon with the Looting enchantment, its level is increased by one
instead.$(br2)To recharge a dun Slaughtergleam, activate the gem while you have a gold nugget in your inventory. The gold nugget is consumed.
